same_version_merge_effect: union active_features only, no conflict purge, no winner replacement
exclusion_effect: skip edge and entire child subtree
optional_weak_rule: skip optional edges unless child crate is also listed in declared
workspace_pin_resolution_reason: workspace when crate appears in workspace_pins

conflict_severity.hard: selected_version major differs from any rejected_versions major
conflict_severity.soft: all rejected_versions share major with selected_version
